meta.name: scheduled-catalog-refresh
meta.description: Render a promotable refresh bulletin from a schedule-owned timestamp and dataset label.

argv:
python3 - <<'PY'
import datetime as dt
import json
import pathlib

request = json.loads(pathlib.Path("../inputs/capture_schedule_context/request").read_text())
scheduled_at = dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(request["scheduled_at_unix_ms"] / 1000, tz=dt.timezone.utc)
timestamp = scheduled_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
report_lines = [
    "# " + request["refresh_label"],
    "",
    "Dataset: " + request["dataset_name"],
    "Scheduled at: " + timestamp,
    "Scheduled at unix ms: " + str(request["scheduled_at_unix_ms"]),
]
out_dir = pathlib.Path("../outputs/publish")
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(out_dir / "report.md").write_text("\n".join(report_lines) + "\n")
(out_dir / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps({
    "refresh_label": request["refresh_label"],
    "dataset_name": request["dataset_name"],
    "scheduled_at_unix_ms": request["scheduled_at_unix_ms"],
    "scheduled_at_utc": timestamp
}, indent=2) + "\n")
PY

cache.reason: scheduled publication should be regenerated for every emitted schedule slot
